name: Redis Inspector
description: Inspect and manage Redis: health, keyspace stats, key lookups, clients, slowlog and runtime configuration. Automatically uses a Docker redis container when redis-cli is not installed on the host.
author: VibeShell

actions.name: Ping
actions.description: Check that the Redis server answers.
args: c="$0"; if [ -n "$c" ]; then exec docker exec -i "$c" redis-cli "$@"; fi; if command -v redis-cli >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec redis-cli "$@"; fi; c=$(docker ps --format "{{.Names}}" 2>/dev/null | grep -i redis | head -n 1); [ -n "$c" ] && exec docker exec -i "$c" redis-cli "$@"; echo "redis-cli not found and no redis container detected" >&2; exit 127
